_note: Per-site model catalogue. tier: small | medium | large. relative_price: estimated usage cost relative to the cheapest model on that site (1 = cheapest) - these are ESTIMATES, edit freely. aliases: lowercase text matched against the site's model picker label. Logic never hard-codes model names; it only reads this file.
_evaluateModeNote: free = Nemotron decides model/effort/saving and writes tips (SPEC design). codes = fallback: Nemotron classifies + picks tip codes, the rules below decide the rest. Choose based on bench/ results.
_rulesNote: Used in 'codes' mode, and by bench/ to score consistency. The cheapest catalogue model in the tier is recommended.

claude._familiesNote: Defaults for any model read from the site's picker, by the first word of its name (e.g. a new 'Sonnet 6' gets the sonnet entry). best_for here is a heuristic; researched facts (src/background/research.js, sourced from the web via Tavily) replace it.
claude._researchNote: Model research looks only at these official domains (Tavily include_domains).
claude._modelsNote: Fallback list until the picker has been read, and exact-model overrides (matched by id = site + name).

chatgpt._note: Fill in when the ChatGPT reader is built (SPEC step 7).
